title: clinopodium axillare subsp. uniflorum
intro: Clinopodium axillare subsp. uniflorum, commonly known as Mountain Mint, is a plant species in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in alleviating digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Mint include relaxing the muscles, reducing fever, and soothing sore throats, making it a popular remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
